fields.label: Rule Set
fields.description: The allocation rules this run applies. Only an Active rule set can be computed.

fields.label: Entity
fields.description: Fetched from the rule set. The run allocates within this entity only.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: Actual or budget. The rule set must apply to this scenario.

fields.label: Fiscal Period
fields.description: The period the allocation posts to. An actual run is refused in a closed period.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set by the workflow: Approved is the submitted document, Cancelled the cancelled one.

fields.label: Amended From
fields.description: The cancelled run this one replaces. Amend opens a new draft that a correction is made in.

fields.label: Method
fields.description: Snapshot of the rule set's method, taken when the weights are computed.

fields.label: Allocation Dimension
fields.description: Snapshot of the rule set's allocation dimension.

fields.label: Rule Set Version
fields.description: The rule set's last-modified time when the weights were computed. Submit refuses the run if the rule set has changed since.

fields.label: Receiver Account
fields.options:
Sender's Own Accounts
Declared Allocation Account
fields.description: Snapshot of the rule set's choice: receivers keep the cost on the sender's accounts, or on one declared allocation account.

fields.label: Allocation Account
fields.description: Snapshot of the declared account that receivers take the cost on. Shown only when the receiver account is declared.

fields.label: Amounts After Approval
fields.options:
Follow Latest Data
Freeze at Approval
fields.description: Snapshot of the rule set's choice. Follow Latest Data uses the current trial balance and budget; Freeze at Approval keeps the amounts as they stood at approval.

fields.label: Values Carried Forward
fields.description: Set when any weight uses a driver value from an earlier period, under the driver's carry-forward option.

fields.label: Computed For Rule Set
fields.description: The rule set the weights were computed for. Submit refuses the run if it no longer matches the Rule Set field.

fields.label: Computed For Scenario
fields.description: The scenario the weights were computed for. Submit refuses the run if it no longer matches the Scenario field.

fields.label: Computed For Fiscal Year
fields.description: The fiscal year the weights were computed for. Submit refuses the run if it no longer matches the Fiscal Year field.

fields.label: Computed For Fiscal Period
fields.description: The fiscal period the weights were computed for. Submit refuses the run if it no longer matches the Fiscal Period field.

fields.label: Weights
fields.description: Written by Compute Weights. One row per sender, receiver, step and driver value.

fields.label: Accounts
fields.description: The cost pool accounts expanded from the rule set, groups included. Written by Compute Weights.
